Query pre-enriched topology links with filtering and pagination. Filterable fields include link_type, status, admin_up, source_site_id, target_site_id, source_wan_if_id, target_wan_if_id, source_wan_nw_id and target_wan_nw_id. Pagination via limit (default 1000, max 5000) and dest_page (1-based).
